The '''Bpfassh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bpfassh]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sluis sector and, consequently, the Bpfassh system, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
